metadata.title: Kuril Islands Militarization Monitor — Areas of Interest
metadata.description: Monitored military facilities on the southern Kuril chain (including the islands Japan claims as the Northern Territories). This is the single editable config for areas of interest; add new sites here without touching code.
metadata.coordinate_sources: Centers verified against open sources (Wikipedia, OpenStreetMap, public airport databases). Airfield centers are precise to the runway; coastal-defense systems are mobile, so those AOIs are broad-area boxes anchored on the named bay/settlement rather than a specific launcher pad. Verify and refine polygons further against current imagery before relying on them for detection.

properties.name: Burevestnik Airbase
properties.name_ja: ブレヴェスニク航空基地
properties.notes: Soviet/Russian military airfield (ICAO UHSB, runway 14/32) on the Vetrovoy isthmus, southeast Iturup, beside Kasatka Bay. Center verified to the runway.

properties.name: Yasny Airbase (Iturup Airport)
properties.name_ja: ヤースヌィ航空基地（イトゥルップ空港）
properties.notes: Joint civil-military airport (ICAO UHSI) ~7 km northeast of Kurilsk; opened 2014, basing Su-35S fighters since 2018. Center verified to the runway.

properties.name: Kasatka Bay (Hitokappu Bay) Coastal Defense Area
properties.name_ja: カサトカ湾（単冠湾）沿岸防衛区域
properties.notes: Kasatka / Hitokappu Bay, anchorage of the 1941 Pearl Harbor strike force; associated with Bal/Bastion coastal-missile activity on Iturup. Broad-area box on the bay (mobile systems have no fixed footprint).

properties.name: Yuzhno-Kurilsk Garrison & Mendeleyevo Airport
properties.name_ja: ユジノクリリスク守備隊・メンデレーエヴォ空港
properties.notes: Box centered on Mendeleyevo Airport (ICAO UHSM); the Yuzhno-Kurilsk garrison and Bal coastal-missile activity are in the wider area to the northeast. Airport center verified.

properties.name: Malokurilskoye Coastal Defense Area
properties.name_ja: マロクリリスコエ沿岸防衛区域
properties.notes: Box on Malokurilskoye settlement and Malokurilsk Bay, Shikotan; site of Russian military buildup. Settlement center verified.

properties.name: Matua Reconstructed Airfield & Base
properties.name_ja: 松輪島 再建飛行場・基地
properties.notes: Reconstructed airfield (new ~1.4 km runway built 2016-2019) and forward base on Matua; reported Bastion battery. Airfield center verified.
